cards.prompt: You're filling in a new public profile. Drag each into a bin.
cards.explanation: A school and where you are can find you, and a first pet's name can unlock a password reset.

cards.prompt: Jo deleted an embarrassing photo last year. Now it's back online. How?

image.alt: Left: Jo's phone says Post deleted, last year. Right: a different phone shows the same photo, a cartoon kid mid-sneeze, shared in a group chat today.

options.text: Someone saved a copy before it was deleted
Deleted posts come back after a year
The app puts popular posts back up

cards.explanation: Deleting removes your copy, but saved copies and screenshots can last.

cards.prompt: Four problems on a public account. Match each to the switch that fixes it.

pairs.left: An app shows where you are

cards.explanation: Each switch controls one thing: posts, messages, location or tags.

cards.prompt: Someone from a game chat offers a gift, then asks your suburb. What do you do?

image.alt: A chat with GiftBuddy_4, a gift-box picture with no face: i'll send u a gift! what suburb r u in? send a pic so i know it's u. The chat's menu shows Block and Report.

options.text: Send your suburb, not a photo
Make your account private, then reply
Report, block and tell a trusted adult

cards.explanation: A suburb and a photo can find you: report, block and tell a trusted adult. It's not your fault.

cards.prompt: Four apps each ask for one thing. Drag each into a bin.
cards.explanation: Allow what fits the app's job: an alarm clock or calculator has no use for your contacts or mic.

cards.prompt: A bus timetable app asks for your location to find nearby stops. Tap the best button.

image.alt: A bus timetable app with a map of nearby bus stops. Over it, a pop-up: Allow Bus Times to use your location? with three buttons: Always (even when closed), Only while using the app, and Don't allow.

cards.explanation: It finds your stops while you're using it, and can't see where you are once you stop.

cards.prompt: At the pool, two Wi-Fi networks show up. You want to watch a video. What first?

image.alt: Your Wi-Fi list at the pool: Pool_Guest with two bars and Pool_Free_WiFi with four bars. Below, the pool's front desk with a staff member, and the water beside it.

options.text: Join the one with more bars
Ask staff which one is theirs
Join the one with Free in its name

cards.explanation: Anyone can pick a network's name or sit close for strong bars; staff know their own.

cards.prompt: You need to check your bank account at a café. What's the safest way to go online?

image.alt: Your phone at a café table: the café's Wi-Fi list, CornerCafe and CornerCafe_Free, and a separate switch, Mobile data, which is off. Beside it, a banking app: Your Bank.

options.text: Any network with the café's name
The network with the strongest signal

cards.explanation: On public Wi-Fi you can't always be sure which network is real, so use mobile data for money.
